lp_vault_address_updatable.meaning: launchpadLPVault address can be changed/updated post-deploy via updateLaunchpadLPVault()

factory_lp_fixed_at_construction.meaning: factory stores launchpadLp as a constructor-time constant fixed at construction

pair_queried_lp_vault.meaning: launchpadLPVault address the pair uses at fee-computation time (should be queried from Launchpad at use-time)

launchpad_current_lp_vault.meaning: current launchpadLPVault() value returned by Launchpad at use-time

fee_computation_at_use_time.meaning: the pair is computing/distributing fees at use-time (the intent's own applicability scope)

fee_revenue_dos_scope.meaning: protocol fee revenue is effectively DoSed for all subsequently graduated markets
fee_revenue_dos_scope.checkpoint: after graduation of markets following the LP vault update

assumptions: The pair's fee computation reads a launchpadLPVault address observable at use-time.
The Launchpad exposes a current launchpadLPVault() getter observable at use-time.

unresolved.description: The intent also requires querying distributor() at use-time; the selected impact evidence concerns only the stale launchpadLp balanceOf read, so the distributor correspondence is not encoded in this claim.
The impact 'effectively DoSing fee revenue' has no numeric magnitude or threshold; encoded as a grounded Boolean outcome.

limitations: The correspondence condition uses the factory-fixed-at-construction P fact as the applicability scope; the intent's own scope is 'when computing/distributing fees', which is not separately observable in the supplied statements.

The impact is a downstream consequence (zero fee share, no distribution) rather than a direct address mismatch; the post-generation audit must assess whether the correspondence witness and the DoS outcome are linked by the report.
